stdout_contract.description: input() prompts go to stdout even with piped stdin (the input itself is not echoed). Line 1 'please input base RNA: ' (trailing space), line 2 'please input mismatched RNA: ' (trailing space), line 3 = repr(float) of the sigmoid output, then a newline. Nothing else on stdout; stderr is empty on success.
stdout_contract.parse_rule: require exit 0; take the last non-empty stdout line, strip it, call float(). Optionally assert the first two lines are the prompts. kon is in (0,1) (sigmoid).
stdout_contract.files_written: no result files. Side effects: main.py creates an empty ./result in cwd if it is absent; Python writes scripts/__pycache__/*.pyc on the first run. mismatch.txt is written only by -m 2/3.

run_to_run.conclusion: Deterministic: model.eval() is called and calculate_kon has no randomness, so the 3 runs are byte-identical. Suggested tolerance: exact string match, or abs 1e-7 on the float to absorb platform/BLAS differences.

replay_check.description: run.sh re-executed from the saved inputs in data/ into outputs/replay; every stdout compared by sha256, and every exit status compared

error_cases_summary.e_len_19_vs_18: exit 1; both prompts on stdout; stderr traceback ends 'Exception: The length of mismatched RNA is not 19 nt!' (raised after the 2nd input). From reading the source (not run): a wrong-length base raises 'The length of base RNA is not 19 nt!' after the 1st input.
error_cases_summary.f1_lowercase: exit 1; lowercase passes the length check, then one_hot_encode fails with "KeyError: 'u'" in the stderr traceback (no case normalisation)
error_cases_summary.f2_T_containing: exit 1; DNA T is not accepted; one_hot_encode fails with "KeyError: 'T'"

observed_hazards: Interactive input(): sequences can only be passed on stdin, and the prompts also go to stdout, so a wrapper must parse the last line.
The model path is relative ('model/mismatch_model.pth') and is loaded when scripts/mismatch.py is imported, which main.py does unconditionally, so cwd must be the OligoFormer root in every mode.
main.py creates ./result in cwd as a side effect.

The only input check is length 19: lowercase, T, N or other characters crash with a bare KeyError traceback. A wrapper should validate or uppercase the input before calling (and decide whether to convert T->U), or report the KeyError as a tool error.

Upstream behaviour, recorded and not fixed: the identical pair scores 0.991731584072113, LOWER than the 1-mismatch reference pair (0.9940418601036072). The score is a learned value and is not guaranteed to peak at 0 mismatches.
limitations: Tested only on CPU, macOS arm64.
kon is whatever the upstream model defines; upstream publishes no reference values for these pairs.

attempts.result: success on the first try (setup + 10 cases + replay); the first report-building script had a glob bug that was fixed, with no re-execution
